quests.title: Secret Forest (One Island): Latios, Latias and the Soul Dew

acquisitions.conditions: During League HQ round 4, after the Lake of Rage Petrel scene, speak to Bianca in Alto Mare Library and follow her on One Island into the Secret Forest. The library meeting needs Island Pilgrimage registration. Defeat Will and Karen, then Goh. Accept Latias and Latios together with two free party slots.
